additional_info.subject: RE: ID0404010-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R4 313059181006] DC3-DC4 Errorcode:8 CRM:01410001442
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Power saver mode is feature for updated firmware version.
When power saver mode is activated and no charging processes are active, the main switch (QA1) opens after 3 minutes, disconnecting the power line (including the converters) from the mains. This is the reason behind the converter error you were experiencing.
We will reboot the charger and try manual convertor regrouping once charging stops for troubleshooting existing errors. If the issue doesn't resolve here we'll continue the analyses ahead.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavy Gurav

additional_info.body:
Dear Yunus,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0404010 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Maybe
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Spare Part Ordering
Maybe
Performance monitoring by RC
The error was due to the dispenser Warning - Selftest has failed and it arises due to Early warning of possible Dispenser PLC cooling fans malfunctioning.
Note
: The self-test is performed at each boot-up of the dispenser where the cooling fans are power-cycled on-off from dispenser-PLC for multiple times in short duration cycles. If the ok signal reported by fan is lost even after a delay of ON command to the fan, it denotes self test error.
P
ossible solutions:
1.
check electrical wiring of cooling circuit for tightness
2.
check if cooling air filters are clean and not blocking
3.
perform preventive maintenance and check by multiple reboots if the self test is failing, then it could be early sign that the cooling fan may fail later and it is recommended to start thinking about spares
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shrey Sharma
